description: An admitted international student is about to move to the UK for a master's program. They need to learn about enrollment registration, housing, bank account setup, and visa considerations.

user_profile.persona: 23-year-old recent graduate, admitted to a UK university
user_profile.context: Departing in one month, preparing all pre-arrival logistics

fact_sheet.fact: The MSc in Data Analytics program at the University of Westhaven has a program code of 'UOW-DA-M24'.
Online enrollment for the Autumn term must be completed via the WesthavenConnect student portal at https://connect.westhaven.ac.uk/enroll by September 15th, 2024.
Course registration for modules DA501 (Advanced Statistics) and DA502 (Machine Learning Foundations) opens on September 18th, 2024 at 10:00 AM GMT.
The mandatory international student orientation is scheduled for September 12th, 2024, in the Grand Hall, Ashton Building.
Your Biometric Residence Permit (BRP) must be collected from the Westhaven Post Office at 14 Market Street, Westhaven, WH1 2BC, within 10 days of your arrival in the UK.
To complete in-person registration, you must present your original passport, visa vignette, and the University of Westhaven offer letter at the Student Services Hub, ground floor, Miller Building.
A 'Proof of Student Status' letter, required for bank account opening, can be downloaded from the 'Documents' section of the WesthavenConnect portal after completing online enrollment.
Your Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies (CAS) number is WHN789456123UKVI, which was issued on July 10th, 2024.
The remaining tuition fee balance of £12,500 must be paid by October 31st, 2024.
The 'Westhaven Global Scholar' award provides a £2,000 tuition fee discount, which will be automatically applied to your second tuition installment.
Britannia Global Bank offers a student account with no monthly fees, which can be pre-booked for an appointment at https://britannia.co.uk/student-appoint.
To open a UK student bank account, you generally need your passport, BRP, and the University's 'Proof of Student Status' letter; Britannia Global Bank accepts these documents for its student account.
Your assigned room in Northwood Hall is Room 4B, located on the 4th floor.
The move-in date for Northwood Hall is September 10th, 2024, between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM.
A housing deposit of £250 was paid on June 5th, 2024, and is refundable at the end of the 44-week contract period, pending a room inspection.
The address for Northwood Hall is: 25 Chancellor's Way, Westhaven, WH3 5RJ, United Kingdom.
Key collection for Northwood Hall is at the reception desk, where you must show your passport and accommodation offer email to the Residential Life Officer, Mr. David Chen.
You must register with a local General Practitioner (GP); the Westhaven University Health Centre is located on campus and registration forms are available online.
The Immigration Health Surcharge (IHS) of £776 was paid as part of your visa application, granting you access to the National Health Service (NHS).
A monthly student bus pass for the Westhaven city area costs £45 and can be purchased via the 'Westhaven Go' mobile app.
Giffgaff and Voxi are popular Pay-As-You-Go SIM card providers; a SIM can be ordered online to your UK hall address before you arrive.
Your academic advisor is Dr. Alistair Finch, whose office is Room 3.14 in the Department of Computer Science, Turing Building.
The first rent payment of £620 for Northwood Hall is due on September 25th, 2024, via the accommodation portal.
You must obtain a TV Licence if you plan to watch live TV or BBC iPlayer in your room; the annual cost is £159.
The International Student Support office is located in Room G-08 of the Miller Building and their contact email is international.support@westhaven.ac.uk.
Your Student Visa is valid from August 20th, 2024, to January 30th, 2026, allowing for a 4-month wrap-up period after your 12-month course.
Under your Student Visa, you are permitted to work a maximum of 20 hours per week during term-time and full-time during official university holidays.
You must report any changes to your address or contact details to the university's Visa Compliance Team within 7 days via the WesthavenConnect portal.
The Northwood Hall contract includes Wi-Fi access via the 'UoW-ResNet' network, with a download speed of 100 Mbps.
The Welcome Week schedule, including library tours and department introductions, is available on the Westhaven Student Union website at westhavensu.co.uk/welcome24.
The estimated weekly cost of living in Westhaven, excluding rent, is approximately £150-£200, covering food, transport, and social activities.
To prove your right to rent to a private landlord, you will need a 'share code' generated from the UK government website: https://www.gov.uk/prove-right-to-rent.
